wanted.title: Wind That Shakes the Barley, The

candidate.song_name: The Wind That Shakes The Barley

content:
[Verse 1]

[tab]  [ch]Em[/ch]                          [ch]Bm[/ch]
I sat within the valley green sat there with my true love[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Em[/ch]                             [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Bm[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]
And my fond heart strove to choose between the old love and the new love[/tab]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]        [ch]Bm[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
The old for her the new that made me think on Ireland dearly[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                       [ch]G[/ch]        [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Bm[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]
While soft the wind blew down the glade and shook the golden barley[/tab]


[Verse 2]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                    [ch]Bm[/ch]
Twas hard for mournful words to frame to break the ties that bound us[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                              [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Bm[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Ah but harder still to bear the shame of foreign chains around us[/tab]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]Bm[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
And so I said the mountain glen I'll seek at morning early[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
And join the brave united men while soft winds shook the barley[/tab]


[Verse 3]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                               [ch]Bm[/ch]
Twas sad I kissed away her tears her arms around me clinging[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                           [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
When to my ears that fateful shot came out the wild wood ringing[/tab]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                          [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
The bullet pierced my true love's breast in life's young spring so early[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]          [ch]Bm[/ch]         [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
And there upon my breast she died while soft winds shook the barley[/tab]


[Verse 4]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                 [ch]Bm[/ch]
I bore her to some mountain stream and many's the summer blossom[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                              [ch]Bm[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]Bm[/ch]           [ch]Em[/ch]
I placed with branches soft and green about her gore-stained bosom[/tab]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                          [ch]G[/ch]           [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]Em[/ch]
I wept and kissed her clay-cold corpse then rushed o'er vale and valley[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                  [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]Bm[/ch]          [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]Bm[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]
My vengeance on the foe to wreak while soft winds shook the barley[/tab]


[Verse 5]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                       [ch]Bm[/ch]
And it's blood for blood without remorse I've took in Oulart Hollow[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                [ch]Bm[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]Em[/ch]
While to her grave my love's cold corpse where I full soon may follow[/tab]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]Bm[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Around her grave I wander drear noon night and morning early[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                        [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Bm[/ch]         [ch]Em[/ch]
With breaking heart whene'er I hear the wind that shakes the barley[/tab]
